reviewed_interpretation: The single authoritative I031 execution is valid and fully covered: 126 donor and 126 target cases, all seven noise domains with 18 ready donors and 18 benchmarkable targets, matched/negative donor coverage 1.0, exact NS/VAD shipping mirrors, and no authority-boundary violation. The only preregistered joint-coherent operator succeeded at its structural goal: it always emitted an actually observed donor joint frame and reduced algebraic inconsistency to at most 3.0e-8. However structural coherence did not translate into target-reference agreement. On the preregistered pre-ready-speech population (71 paired cases), the frozen control median gap absolute error was 0.0683747085 while the joint-coherent operator error worsened to 0.0873505325; median paired improvement was -0.0082003475, only 32/71 non-tied cases improved (45.07%), and the one-sided sign-test was p=0.8287645008 versus the frozen p<=0.01 support threshold. Global performance was also essentially flat-to-negative (median improvement -0.00026056175, 62 wins versus 64 losses). Living was directionally positive, but bus, field, cafeteria and kitchen were negative, so no condition-stable benefit exists. A deterministic same-evidence sanity check that simply reprojected the frozen control gap to clamp(concentration-mean) also trended worse and is non-authoritative; it only reinforces that another algebraic-only repair is not a high-information next step. Therefore I031 selects no aggregation operator, donor/reference source, component, mapping, threshold or shipping change. The next question moves away from aggregation search: whether a target-side, causally available noise-scale observable can faithfully represent the later target ordinary-noise state and explain frozen-donor transfer error.

primary_directional_review.population: target cases with at least one pre-ready speech disagreement

root_cause_review.note: I031 proves that restoring joint identity alone is insufficient. It does not prove that all donor-reference transfer is unusable, but further aggregation-operator search is not justified by this evidence.

non_authoritative_sanity_check.description: Using the already-consumed I031 evidence only, recomputing the frozen-control gap as clamp(control concentration - control mean) while leaving control mean/concentration unchanged also produced worse descriptive gap error. This was not preregistered and carries no authority.

proposed_followup_hypothesis.rationale: Use entirely fresh, disjoint donor and target public-development seeds. Freeze the I029/I030 donor selection function, K=3, negative-control map and the independent-component-median donor control; do not evaluate another aggregation operator. Add only one target-side causal observable already produced by the frozen probe: ns_noise_rms_dbfs. For each target case with at least one pre-ready speech disagreement, capture ns_noise_rms_dbfs at the first such causal target frame. Retrospectively compare it with the median ns_noise_rms_dbfs over that target case's first eight later ordinary-noise non-disagreement reference frames. Preregister engineering fidelity bounds of median absolute error <=3 dB and 90th-percentile absolute error <=6 dB. Also report, descriptively only, whether absolute frozen-donor versus causal-target noise-scale mismatch co-varies with frozen donor gap transfer error. This asks whether a deployable target-side state observable is faithful enough to explain/adapt donor transfer before any normalization rule or candidate is designed.
required_gates: fresh donor and target seeds disjoint from I025-I031
I029/I030 donor selection function, K=3 and negative-control map frozen unchanged
first pre-ready-speech ns_noise_rms_dbfs captured causally at target time
target later eight-frame ordinary-noise ns_noise_rms_dbfs used only as retrospective benchmark
median causal-proxy absolute error and p90 error reported
no normalization mapping or component counterfactual executed
prohibited: change of matching priority or negative-control map
search or evaluation of another aggregation operator
assumption that development matching metadata is available in shipping

verification_limits: I031 is development-only; donor matching uses synthetic/development metadata and does not establish shipping metadata availability.
The joint-coherent operator restored algebraic consistency but failed the preregistered primary gap-error hypothesis; this failure must not be reinterpreted as support through domain slices.
Living was directionally positive, but multiple other domains were negative; no domain-specific operator admission is authorized.
The non-authoritative projection sanity check is descriptive only and cannot be treated as a second tested operator.

No aggregation operator, donor/reference source, component, mapping, threshold, normalization rule, validation-grade, blind, HIL, product-certification, source-merge or release authority was selected or consumed.
